messages:
marco_cs: Heads-up 1 Orchid Health onboarding: long-doc summary route has a long tail (p95 ~410ms, p99 ~1.0s) and token cost is drifting up. Renewal check in 9 days. Any low-risk canary suggestions we can push fast?

anya_ml: Two conservative levers: 1) compact-int8 (safe profile) for doc summaries, 2) route requests with token_count>1000 to a small canary pool. Add prefix/KV cache for repeated records.

lee_sre: I can stand up a 5% canary pool and wire a token-length routing rule. Need acceptance criteria (latency + quality) and a rollback plan.

violet_success: Acceptance: p95 <320ms AND summary quality regression <=1.0% (ROUGE/sem-sim). Rollback immediately if client-reported degradations or automated quality checks exceed 1.2%.

anya_ml: Canary snippet (draft):

```yaml
name: orchid-compact-int8-canary
steps:
  - pct: 5
    model: redwood/compact-v2
    quant: int8_safe_G
    cache_prefix: true
    fallback: redwood/llm-standard
metrics:
  - p95_latency
  - summary_quality_delta: "<=1.0%"
```

lee_sre: Applying route: {"route_policy":"token_length","threshold":1000,"destination":"orchid-compact-int8-canary","fallback":"llm-standard"}. Will provision 5% pool and attach tracing.

ops-bot: Canary "orchid-compact-int8-canary" scheduled by lee_sre. Start epoch 6210012000. Monitors: p95, error_rate, quality_delta. Alerts set: p95>320ms, quality_delta>1.0%. :rocket: 

violet_success: Ill schedule a 20m enablement call with orchid eng to review tradeoffs and collect 6-10 representative prompts. If they sign off we run 72h and scale to 25% only if targets met.

marco_cs: Thanks 1 next steps: 1) enablement call (violet to invite), 2) lee provisions 5% canary (ops-bot confirmed), 3) anya finalizes playbook + expected diffs, 4) monitor 72h and collect examples, 5) scale only if p95 <320ms and quality_delta <=1.0%. Ill update renewal tracker after pilot. :thumbsup:
